# Reverie Nails and Spa

> Nail salon in Saginaw, TX. Walk-ins are welcome. Booking ahead is optional if you want a specific technician or a set time.

Reverie Nails and Spa is a nail salon and spa at 4613 W Bailey Boswell Rd, Ste 101, Saginaw, TX 76179, in the same plaza as Dunkin'. The public name is Reverie Nails and Spa. The legal entity is Reverie Nail and Spa Inc., doing business as Reverie Nails and Spa. Open since 2020.

## Contact

- Phone: (682) 224-5688
- Website: https://www.reverienailstx.com/
- Booking: https://book.reverienailstx.com/book
- Email: reverienailandspa@gmail.com
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=7370468993373574136

## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 9:30 AM–7:30 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM–7:00 PM
- Sunday: 11:00 AM–6:00 PM

Walk-ins are welcome during these hours. No appointment is required. Online booking is for a specific technician or a locked-in time.

## Areas guests come from

Saginaw, Fort Worth, Eagle Mountain, Lake Worth, and Haslet, Texas.

## Services and starting prices

Prices are starting points and can vary with length, shape, and nail art. Full list: https://www.reverienailstx.com/menu.html

- Manicures: Classic $20, Aloe Vera $30, Reverie Organic $40. https://www.reverienailstx.com/manicures-saginaw-tx/
- Gel manicures: Classic $38, Aloe Vera $48, Reverie Organic $58. Gel usually lasts 2–3 weeks with care.
- Pedicures: Classic $30 (30 min) through Red Glow $90 (70+ min). https://www.reverienailstx.com/pedicures-saginaw-tx/
- Dip powder: Color set $40. Adding tips $5. https://www.reverienailstx.com/dip-powder-saginaw-tx/
- Acrylic powder: Full set with regular polish $40. https://www.reverienailstx.com/acrylics-saginaw-tx/
- Builder gel: Full set $55. https://www.reverienailstx.com/builder-gel-saginaw-tx/
- Gel-X: Full set $70. https://www.reverienailstx.com/gel-x-saginaw-tx/
- Solar pink and white: Full set $55. https://www.reverienailstx.com/solar-nails-saginaw-tx/
- Kids 8 and under: manicure $15, pedicure $25.
- Waxing is on the menu, from eyebrows $12.
- There is no separate spa-package menu. Longer pedicures (massage, hot stones, paraffin, and the luxe menu) are the spa services.

A manicure takes around 20 minutes. Dip, acrylics, builder gel, and solar take around 45 minutes to an hour. Gel-X takes around an hour. Art and length can add time. Pedicure times are on the pedicure page.

## What is included

- Complimentary drinks with a service. Cocktails, wine, rosé, and water are the ones to mention first.
- Callus remover is included with every pedicure except the Classic. On the Classic it is $5.
- Exfoliation is included with every pedicure, including the kids' pedicure.
- Regular polish is complimentary with a pedicure. Gel on a pedicure is $20. Gel only on toes is $25.
- Metal tools are sanitized in an autoclave. Files and buffers are single-use.
- Free parking in the lot outside Ste 101.
- Military, teachers, and students: mention it for special pricing every day.
- Monday–Thursday before 3 PM: 15% off all services. Cannot be combined with other offers.

## Policies already published

- Cancellation: give as much notice as you can. Repeated no-shows may affect future booking. The website does not list a cancellation fee.
- Appointment texts are optional. Consent is not required to book. Details: https://www.reverienailstx.com/sms-opt-in/

## Gift cards and payment

- Gift cards are sold for a dollar amount the guest chooses.
- Guests can pay with cash, card, or tap.
